title: Farewell Letter
subtitle: Mounting their horses and clenching the reins, young men bid farewell and head to war—a story as old as time.

trails.title: Mounting Procedure and Posture
trails.description: First Opening - Operation Order Brief - Top Secret.

content.text:
Operation Order Brief
[In accordance with Zeno Military Security Protocol, this brief has been encrypted.]

Operation Orders: #Operation Frozen Horseshoe - Ω. "Spear" Light Cavalry Division 0500

1. Mission
    You are ordered to form a rapid strike team with the "Shashka" and "Shield" units, hereby designated "Ω".
    Strike Team "Ω" will coordinate with "Horse Hunter" forces and the "Old Citizen" unit to establish an "Ω Formation" battlefront. Advance upstream along the golden bank of the "Undercurrent" waterway to launch a surprise assault. Your core objective is to restrict enemy deployment space at all costs.

2. Enemy Intel
    Our forces and "Horse Hunter" forces suffered infiltration attacks in "Southern Town." We have confirmed the enemy's new attack target. Enemy "Black Locust" forces are massing on the golden bank of the "Undercurrent" waterway. They are expected to cross in full strength and launch a general offensive against "Southern Town."
    According to reliable intelligence, enemy "Black Locust" forces are expected to mass for attack within the next 24 hours. However, the exact strength of the troops committed to the dark bank of the "Undercurrent" waterway remains unknown.

3. Execution
    Rapidly ford the "Undercurrent" waterway. Before enemy forces complete assembly, execute a flanking maneuver from the narrow wing. Ambush and eliminate all encountered enemy units. Penetrate enemy rear positions and sever supply lines. All combat units must reach the Old Tree riverside sector and assemble before the autumn harvest.

4. Coordination
    "Horse Hunter" forces and the "Old Citizen" unit have been integrated into the "Southern Town" defense network and will conduct diversionary attacks from the dark bank. "Long Tail" forces will provide supporting fire and clean-up.
    Following the extension of the offensive, your unit must immediately engage the enemy and coordinate with friendly forces for encirclement. If you encounter an enemy counterattack, you may request air support.
    Due to logistical constraints, the "Scout Shortsword" camp will assist in securing abandoned horses and equipment recovered during operations.

5. Command and Signals
    Maintain "Status Quo" until next classified order is received.

items.text: Farewell Letter

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: So, you're saying you devised this plan with Igor?
Sternova stands opposite the commander, the map table between them. Agitated, she shifts the markers representing the military forces back and forth.
The commander glances up at her. Her words are minimal, but her stance is made clear.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Put the gryphon down, Sabina. We're all in the same boat now.
Sternova raises a hand and sweeps the wooden gryphon to the edge of the table.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: I'm not questioning your orders, but I will state for the record that leaving our back wide open to Igor is too risky.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: After dark, the cavalry will advance upstream with minimal gear to launch a surprise attack, cutting off Krutov's supply lines.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: It makes sense. Our riders know the terrain like the back of their hand; this will allow us to capitalize on our superior mobility.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: But we would be leaving the right bank, the forest, the sich, and even Bereggrad exposed.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: We're throwing ourselves into the old lion's mouth and praying he won't bite!

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: You're right. We'd be exposed. But a coalition without trust wins nothing.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: You've seen Krutov and his army. Neither the Cavalry Corps nor the militia can meet his air power or artillery.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Bereggrad would be rubble if not for Igor's anti-air guns.
Her thoughts drift to the poorhouse, its dome half-destroyed in a bomb dropped during their withdrawal from Bereggrad.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: The Gryphon Legion is well-equipped, but they're thin on numbers and supplies. They will hold cities and forests best.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Let them guard the city. Our riders will flank the enemy by night. Both Igor and I agree on this.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: But ...
She knows the commander has reasons, yet the smoke of South America still hangs heavy in her memory, casting an inescapable shadow over this coalition.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: I hear your concerns, Sabina.
He picks up the wooden gryphon and sets it down on the sich.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: When the operation begins, Igor will come to our sich. All his communication will be monitored.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: How? I doubt our operators can tap his lines so effectively.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: There will be no such need. On our return from the city, I asked Igor to use only our lines for the operation.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: He agreed.
Sternova nods hesitantly.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: I see. Still, I'll be keeping an eye on him.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Your scrutiny is welcome, Colonel Sternova.
The rebel leader enters the tent, his presence tightening the already frayed nerves of the chief of staff.
Under Sternova's piercing gaze, he places a document on the table.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: What's this?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: All the information I have on Krutov: his background, academic record, military experience, psychological profile, and a registered list of his arcane skills.
The information comes like rain upon a desert. Such clear proof of good faith silences Sternova's worries. She silently agrees to allow the collaboration to continue.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Thank you. We know little of Krutov. I'll be sure to read this before we begin.
Under the high noon sun, blurred shadows fall across the canvas wall of the tent.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: Hm? Who's that gathering outside?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: I saw some officers discussing something in camp. It may be them.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Let us hear what they have to say, Sabina.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: This is ...
Just as Igor predicted, there is a group of officers standing outside the tent.
Their hands rest along the seams of their trousers, their faces each wearing a complicated, cautious expression.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Why are you out here jabbering when you should be making preparations?
The leader of the 5th Regiment takes a small step forward and delivers a textbook salute.

items.speaker: "Goat"
items.text: Commander, I am here to make a request of you. On behalf of the men, sir.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: I'm listening.
He draws a deep breath. The goatee upon his chin trembles slightly.

items.speaker: "Goat"
items.text: As you know, many of our comrades have homes nearby—families. We formally request a half-day's leave to visit them.

items.speaker: "Goat"
items.text: I swear to you, sir. Not a single rider will shirk their duties. We are Cossacks, true, ready to shed blood on the battlefield.

items.speaker: "Goat"
items.text: We were born soldiers of the steppe, just as our fathers were, and theirs before them.

items.speaker: "Goat"
items.text: We know that not all of us will live to see the rising of the sun tomorrow. So, if we have a chance to see our loved ones ...
He clenches his teeth. Facing the commander, the speech he prepared seems to have slipped from his mind.
So he simply remains silent. After all, the most important request has already been made.
The commander clasps his hands behind his back, his gaze sweeping over the rows of Cossack military caps.
The soldiers follow his eyes. No one dares break the silence.
Then, he waves a hand.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: A half-day. No more. Go see your families.
A bittersweet cheer erupts from the soldiers.
The feeling spreads quickly throughout the camp, the other soldiers soon learning of the commander's answer from the rising fervor.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: Anyone who fails to return to the sich before nightfall will be branded as a deserter. Do I make myself clear?
The cavalrymen disperse to the tune of "Yes, sir" and "Thank you, sir." The commander lets out a long sigh and meets Sternova's eyes.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: Will you be paying a visit to Tamarovka?

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: No.
He shakes his head.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: There is much to prepare. Come. Let us return to it.
The commander sets a pile of blank letter paper on the table and pushes it toward Sternova.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Pass these papers to any soldier not going home. Tell them to write a letter if they wish.
Sternova's gaze darkens. She glances at the commander, to Igor, and back again.
Then, at last, she nods. She gathers the paper, turns, and leaves the makeshift meeting room.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Not the wisest choice—sending them home just before a major operation. Their families will plead for them to stay.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: But they will return. All of them. You share their blood, Igor, you should know this.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: And a Cossack will do anything to protect their home and family. The embrace of those they fight to protect will only sharpen their resolve.
The commander pours himself and his temporary ally a cup of dark tea spiced with pepper.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Maybe you think you know them, but they know little of you and even less about what Zeno expects of them.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: They will be sent to other battlefields, away from their homes. Their homesickness will be a liability.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: They knew what service meant when they enlisted. Though, I cannot say if they are truly ready to leave their homeland behind.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Homeland ... Every war is fought on someone's home, yet its name is used to forge the young into unbreakable soldiers. It seems you still understand this.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: But tell me, Ivan, why don't you go to Tamarovka? The roads should still be safe.
Ivan lifts his cup and takes a sip.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Or is it that the Don of this era is no home to you? Are you afraid to tell your soldiers the truth?
The commander adjusts the collar of his uniform, searching for a way to change the subject.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Ha. I don't answer to you anymore, Igor. In fact, you're one of mine now. You should join them.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Join them? What do you mean?

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Write a letter to your loved ones.
The unexpected proposal renders Igor silent.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Krutov bears a grudge against you. It is clear. If we fail, he will show you no mercy.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: So, anyone to bid farewell to? Or is this era truly just a fleeting wind to you?
Igor drinks the hot tea in one gulp. He rises and pulls on his coat.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: I'll leave you to your work.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: After this battle, Igor, I hope never to see you again.
Taking a few sheets of letter paper from the commander's desk, Igor steps out of the tent.
The commander remains standing, as if waiting for something to arrive. Soon, the radio linked to headquarters chirps its alarming tone as expected.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Vice Admiral Burakov, is the Timekeeper safe?

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Yes. She says her mission in Bereggrad is mostly complete.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Good. We'll relay this to the Foundation Committee.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: With that settled, your orders are to pull the Cavalry Corps from the region, effective immediately.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Immediately? We were given two weeks to secure Bereggrad.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: A warlord and his bandits, aided by Manus Vindictae, have been running rampant on the Don. We are working to neutralize this threat before redeployment.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Manus Vindictae's forces are concentrated on the Western Front. Our manpower is already stretched too thin. We can't afford to hold the Don River, not while there are more important strategic goals.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: The decision is set. No two weeks.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Five days, that's all I ask. We will resolve the threat here and ride to Hungary without delay.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: And how do you plan to "resolve the threat"? With Igor's rebels?

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Did you really think you could hide your coalition with Igor and his traitors? Irinei only turned a blind eye for the Timekeeper's sake.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: But the Timekeeper has finished her work, and you are still collaborating with them.

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Are you prepared to face the Committee if they demand an explanation?

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Vice Admiral Burakov, do you read me?

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: Ivan Ivanovich, you understand what I'm saying, don't you?

items.speaker: Zeno Command Liaison Officer
items.text: You'll obey orders, or you'll face the consequences, Ivan!

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: To protect our home and kin. That is why I stand with Igor's rebels.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: That will be my only answer to the tribunal.
